scope.intended_use: Compact two-drawer desk organizer with removable six-bin sorter, continuous containment walls, coherent rounded fronts, and a recognizable carbon-twill appearance for dry indoor stationery storage.
scope.user_context: The owner rejected 2.0.0-draft.1 on 2026-09-05 because its carbon cue, corner continuity, front-language consistency, and apparent fit quality were inadequate. This assessment governs the corrective digital revision; exact printer, filament, and slicer profile remain unknown.
out_of_scope: A physical fit claim without a process-matched coupon
A load, cycle-life, safety, or commercial-release claim

interfaces.name: Drawer body sliding inside housing bay

assembly.sequence_notes: Print the fit coupon for the exact process before committing a full print.

evidence.uncertainty_note: Nominal CAD values are exact, but process compensation and long-part warp are unqualified.

failure_modes.mode: Drawer binds, rattles, or collides during travel
failure_modes.effect: Loss of intended access and possible cosmetic damage
failure_modes.mitigation: Keep rails smooth, verify full motion envelope digitally, then select clearance from a process-matched coupon.

acceptance_criteria: No CAD collision across full insertion travel.
Selected coupon pair slides through the full test length without force or objectionable rattle.

evidence.uncertainty_note: CAD clearance is verified; physical insertion and retention are not.

failure_modes.mode: Sorter pegs bind or the sorter rocks
failure_modes.effect: Module cannot be seated or feels unstable
failure_modes.mitigation: Verify socket depth and lateral clearance, then test the stack coupon/full prototype.

acceptance_criteria: All four pegs clear their sockets without bottoming in CAD.
Printed sorter seats fully and can be removed by hand without damage.

interfaces.name: Continuous housing and sorter containment corners

dimensions.feature: Minimum continuous nominal wall at rounded containment corners

keepouts_and_access: No rectangular pocket may break through a rounded outer corner.
Drawer and compartment access must remain unobstructed.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The failure mechanism is identified; corrected minimum-wall evidence is pending the new build.

failure_modes.mode: Rectangular cavity intersects rounded exterior and removes corner wall
failure_modes.effect: Visible open corners, loss of small-item containment, weak and poor-quality appearance
failure_modes.mitigation: Use matched rounded pocket geometry and deterministic corner-section probes.

acceptance_criteria: All defined housing-rear and sorter-top corner probes intersect positive wall material.
No zero-thickness or open containment corner is visible in orthographic review.

interfaces.name: Rounded front language and carbon-twill appearance

evidence.uncertainty_note: The desired family is clear; appearance and tactile acceptance require process-matched coupons under three light angles.

failure_modes.mode: Pattern reads as coarse crosshatch or mesh triangulation rather than twill
failure_modes.effect: The named carbon appearance and perceived product quality are not met
failure_modes.mitigation: Use a compact 2x2 twill field, remove wireframe mesh edges from presentation, and compare plain/coarse/medium/fine coupons.

acceptance_criteria: Pattern is recognized as a stylized carbon twill at normal desk distance under three light angles.
Drawer fronts form continuous rounded reveals with the housing.
No snagging or sharp hand-contact edge is observed.

drivers: INT=3: long sliding drawers, a four-point removable stack interface, containment walls, and appearance keep-outs interact.
PAR=3: one parametric source controls five printable artifacts and derived STEP/STL/3MF evidence.
VER=3: geometry, motion, fit coupon, texture coupon, exact slicing, and physical appearance require distinct gates.

blocking_unknowns: qualified XY sliding clearance for the exact printer/material/nozzle/profile
exact machine, filament product, slicer version, and complete process profile
physical drawer travel/cycle, sorter seating, anti-tip, and texture-appearance results

criticality.rationale: In dry indoor desk use, credible failures are binding, rattling, small-item loss, snagging, and limited surface/property damage; no high-energy or safety-rated claim is made.

decision.rationale: Proceed with a corrective digital draft and deterministic geometry/motion checks. Keep print-candidate, fit/function, appearance, safety, and commercial release blocked until the exact process, coupons, slicer preview, and human review exist.

warnings.message: Nominal CAD clearances are defined but physical sliding clearance remains unqualified for the exact process.
The exact printer, filament, and complete slicer profile are still unknown; exact slicing remains fail-closed.

next_actions.action: Correct the matched rounded pocket geometry, drawer-front silhouette, and twill representation.
next_actions.exit_criterion: New STEP/STL artifacts pass solid, corner-continuity, full-travel, protected-surface, and visual-review checks.

next_actions.action: Qualify XY sliding clearance on the exact printer/material/nozzle/profile.
next_actions.exit_criterion: A measured fit coupon selects a clearance and the unchanged full-length drawer passes insertion and travel.

next_actions.action: Run the exact Anycubic slicer adapter if an Anycubic destination and complete profiles are selected.
next_actions.exit_criterion: A fresh isolated slice records the binary/profile/input hashes, native PASS result, G-code hash, and manual layer/seam/support review.

basis_refs: owner correction dated 2026-09-05 in the active design review
